Du arbeitest extrem individuell, genießt volle Eigenverantwortung und stimmst dich gleichzeitig direkt und auf Augenhöhe mit uns ab.
Deine Mission? Du hältst unsere Ladeinfrastruktur am Laufen und baust das operative Rückgrat unseres E-Mobility-Geschäfts auf. Egal ob Laden am Arbeitsplatz ( charge@work ), die smarte Abrechnung für Dienstwagen zu Hause ( charge@home ) oder weltweites Roaming ( charge@public ) – du steuerst die Prozesse über unser Backoffice.
Kurzum: Ein extrem abwechslungsreicher Job, bei dem du deinen Bereich komplett selbstständig managst und prägst!
Aufgaben
Projekt-Onboarding: Operative Abwicklung von B2B-Kundenprojekten nach dem Sales-Handover von der Bereitstellung bis zur fertigen Inbetriebnahme.
Plattform-Steuerung: Betreuung und Pflege unserer E-Mobility-Software, Einrichtung und Onboarding von Kundenzugängen
Tarifverwaltung: Verwaltung sowie Einbindung von Roaming- und Ladetarifen.
Technical Support: 2nd/3rd-Level-Support inklusive Remote-Entstörung von AC-/DC-Ladestationen und Hilfestellung bei Ladeproblemen.
Uptime-Monitoring: Überwachung der Verfügbarkeit unserer öffentlichen und privaten Ladeinfrastruktur für einen reibungslosen Betrieb.
Abrechnungswesen: Optimierung und Durchsteuerung von Abrechnungsprozessen sowie Abwicklung von Betriebskosten.
Reporting & Service: Erstellung und Auswertung von Daten-Exports für Kunden sowie Ausstellen und Versenden von Ladekarten.
Qualifikation
System- & Branchenerfahrung: Idealerweise Vorkenntnisse sowie Verständnis für E-Mobility-Konzepte (CPO, EMSP, Roaming).
Technisches Grundverständnis: Vertrautheit mit Schnittstellen wie OCPP/OCPI oder die Bereitschaft, dich zügig tiefer einzuarbeiten.
Analytisches & kaufmännisches Denken: Zahlen, Tarife und Abrechnungsprozesse machen dir Spaß und du findest schnell logische Zusammenhänge.
Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und behältst im operativen Alltagsgeschäft den Überblick.
Lösungsorientierung: Du bleibst auch bei kniffligen technischen Ladeproblemen ruhig und agierst stets kunden- und serviceorientiert.
Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst eigene Ideen zur Prozessoptimierung ein und treibst deine Themen voran.

At Foxelli Group , we're not just leading the digital marketplace - we're redefining it. With 10 years of experience and a portfolio of thriving direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands generating over $20 million USD annually, we’re pushing boundaries to achieve our next growth milestone.

That’s why we’re on the hunt for an Operations Manager who’s ready to make a real impact. ❕This role is 100% remote, and you will join a team that already works from 20 different world countries. THE ROLE We’re on a mission to make work smarter, faster , and more impactful .

As an Operations Manager , you’ll be at the heart of our efforts to refine internal processes, resolve inefficiencies, and drive impactful improvements in collaboration with our COO.

This role is perfect for someone who loves to uncover and eliminate the root causes of operational challenges, creating systems that empower teams to work at their best. RESPONSIBILITIES Identify and Fix Inefficiencies: Analyze workflows across teams to uncover inefficiencies, gaps, or breakdowns in communication.

Propose and implement solutions to streamline operations and standardize processes.. Optimize Systems: Oversee and maintain our OKRs system, ensuring it reflects up-to-date data. Lead the migration from Excel to the best-fit OKR platform for our company, creating a seamless transition.

Enhance Collaboration: Establish and improve communication flows to ensure teams are aligned and information is not lost or delayed. This includes summarizing key takeaways from managerial meetings, distilling what truly matters, and transforming insights into clear, actionable leaflets to improve internal communication.

Strategic Initiatives: Work closely with the COO to identify non-functional areas, develop action plans, and drive strategic initiatives that enhance company operations. Root Cause Analysis: Dig deep into recurring challenges to uncover and address underlying issues, preventing future roadblocks.

Requirements SKILLS & EXPERIENCE A natural problem-solver is passionate about optimizing business operations and creating impactful change. Hands-on experience in e-commerce business operations or similar roles. Strong skills in process mapping, workflow visualization, and system improvement.

Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with a talent for asking the right questions, gathering insights, and drawing actionable conclusions. Familiarity with OKRs systems and platforms, with experience in transitioning between tools.

Proficiency in tools like Asana (or similar project management platforms) and Excel for data analysis and reporting. A proactive mindset, ready to take ownership of challenges and deliver long-term solutions. Strong leadership and a collaborative mindset. Results-driven with a focus on measurable outcomes.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS 10 min online DISC assessment to identify your behavioral style, as we strongly believe in the power of diverse teams. 15-30 min intro e-meet with Foxelli Group CPO to discuss company, role, your experiences, and expectations. 60-90 min e-meet with Foxelli Group board members - CEO, CCO, COO, and CPO to discuss: the vision of the role, your competencies, and technical skills.

Have a both-sided Q&A session. Home Task. Decision & Feedback from us. SALARY €1,500 - €2,500 after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience, with the potential for quarterly performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs. ❕Please note that this role requires a self-employment certificate.

PERKS & BENEFITS Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and keeping your physical well-being in check. A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep continuously growing.

Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested . A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrates you .

Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting for your control of a working day, powered by Hubstaff for transparency and fairness. ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3 .

We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

Responsible for planning and directing the operations in the facility; or planning and directing multiple support activities for the facility such as training, quality assurance, traffic management, airspace and procedures, plans and programs, and other facility program areas.

Directs a highly technical workforce that provides either air traffic control services and/or tactical and strategic support. The work impacts the effectiveness and efficiency of the day-to day operations of the facility.

Work typically impacts the safe, orderly, and expeditious movement of aircraft as well as the efficient operation of segments of the aviation industry. Provides training, coaching and guidance to subordinates and facilitates team building throughout area(s) of responsibility.

Integrates support resources with operational needs to maintain effective air traffic control service, and may work other than administrative shifts to meet this requirement.

Using measures of organizational performance, continuously reviews work processes to assure that results meet the agency's mission and the customer's needs, adds value to facility services, and are efficiently achieved. Assigns and reviews work. Plans work and sets priorities and schedules.

Approves leave; prepares schedules for completion of work; assigns work to subordinates based on priorities; evaluates work performance of subordinates ensuring equity of performance standards and ratings; gives advice on work and on administrative matters; Identifies and arranges for developmental and other training needs of subordinates.

Makes decisions on work problems presented by subordinates; hears and resolves group grievances and serious employee complaints; effects disciplinary actions; recommends/approves selections and transfers; recommends/approves awards. Deals with labor representatives concerning workforce issues.

Adjusts staffing levels and work procedures to accommodate resource decisions made at higher levels. Provides input to and contributes to the accomplishment of facility goals and objectives. Serves as a member of the management team to improve organizational performance and to meet strategic goals.

Communicates and reinforces diversity and EEO policies and programs in all areas of responsibility, including selections, training, and transfers. Participates in the labor-management partnership process and fosters a work environment where all employees are treated in a fair and equitable manner.

Meets and has frequent contacts with both internal and external customers including subordinates, other peer management representatives, union representatives, administrative support staff within the facility, higher ranking managers and supervisors, members of the general public, and representatives of the aviation industry.

The Operations Manager reports to the Air Traffic Manager. Performance is evaluated upon the effectiveness with which assigned program objectives are achieved.
To qualify for this position you: 1. Must have held an FAA 2152 FV-J/FG-14 or above regional or headquarters position for at least 1 year (52 weeks); OR 2.

Must have been facility rated or area certified for at least 1 year (52 weeks) in an ATS facility; (NOTE: An employee who has been facility rated or area certified for at least 1 year (52 weeks) in an ATS facility that is upgraded is considered to meet the qualification requirements of the upgraded position, since he/she has been performing the higher-graded work); OR 3.

Must have held a MSS position or above for at least 1 year (52 weeks) in an ATS facility. 4.

In addition to the qualifications listed above for this MSS position, you must have held the MSS-2 position OR an FG-2152-14 or above regional or headquarters position for 1 year (52 weeks) [IAW Qualification Requirements for AT-2152 Terminal and En Route Positions (Revision 1) dated 11/08/99].

Qualifications must be met by the closing date of this announcement. We are not accepting applications from noncitizens.

The Lead Technical Operations Analyst will provide production support for, and automation of, financial services production processes.

This role will coordinate and oversee production processes for EASY applications to help ensure compliance with regulatory and client Service Level Agreements, respond to and mitigate production-critical program failures, perform root-cause analysis, identify automation opportunities, provide customer service, model best practices for less senior team members, and advise the manager on team and initiative status.

What you will do:
Create, schedule, and monitor back-end applications for transactional processing using the CA Workload Automation tool, AutoSys.
Monitor and maintain the EASY Workload Automation Tool to ensure timely processing of financial transactions.
Monitor production performance of back-end processes, mitigate program failures, and escalate major system issues to other support teams in the organization.
Respond to service ticket requests from business users, system developers, and clients to perform requested tasks within the scope of team responsibilities.
Use a service ticketing system to respond to requests for assistance regarding transaction processing.
Access the EASY system code base and databases to investigate program failures.
Communicate with development teams to report production issues and risks that require development effort to repair or mitigate.
Advise on and work on or lead strategic initiatives to mitigate or alleviate back-end application issues, including opportunities for process automation.

s.h: Present automation opportunities to developers on the team.

Assist less senior team members with decision-making when required and may override their decisions when necessary for the benefit of the organization.
Work closely with counterparts in Bangalore and offshore resources to ensure coverage and fluid communication of issues, processes, and status.
Provide excellent internal and external customer service.
May be consulted to offer recommendations on performance appraisals, work schedules, and hiring decisions.
Work occasional overtime and weekends, particularly where communication with offshore resources is concerned.

Customer focus, including listening, patience, empathy, authenticity, proactivity, and perseverance with external and internal customers.

At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.
We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities.

Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive.

Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

Bridge the wealth gap in Europe

Contribute to building a best-in-class product

Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Treasury and other teams to support efficient processes and address challenges as they arise

Die Eigentümer haben die Firma bisher neben ihren bestehenden Unternehmen aufgebaut und geführt. Aufgrund des Wachstums möchte man die operative Verantwortung nun schrittweise an eine engagierte Führungspersönlichkeit übergeben.
Für diese spannende Aufgabe suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und gleichzeitig hands-on orientierte Persönlichkeit als Betriebsleiter:in Reinigung, 80–100%.
*Wie diese Stelle aussieht*
Es handelt sich um eine junge, noch nicht perfekt strukturierte Firma, die mit dieser Stelle bewusst in Vorleistung geht. In den ersten Monaten liegt der Fokus stark auf operativer Mitarbeit – Sie reinigen mit, während gemeinsam die Strukturen aufgebaut werden.

Sie arbeiten sehr selbständig, mit wenig enger Führung – eine wöchentliche operative Sitzung, sonst vieles ad hoc. Erwartet wird, dass Sie aktiv auf Kunden zugehen und selbst Aufträge akquirieren; dafür werden Sie direkt am Erfolg beteiligt. Kurz gesagt: eine Rolle mit viel
Eigenverantwortung, die unternehmerisches Denken und Eigeninitiative wirklich braucht.
*Ihre Aufgaben*
* Operative Führung und Organisation des Tagesgeschäfts
* Aktive Mitarbeit vor Ort, insbesondere in der Anfangsphase – Sie sind sich nicht zu schade, selbst mit anzupacken
* Führung, Betreuung und Einsatzplanung der Mitarbeitenden
* Organisation, Koordination und Kontrolle der laufenden Reinigungsaufträge
* Sicherstellung einer hohen Arbeitsqualität und Kundenzufriedenheit
* Betreuung bestehender Kunden sowie Bearbeitung von Reklamationen und Anliegen
* Aktive Kundenakquise: Erstellung von Offerten, Besuche bei potenziellen Kunden, Ausbau des Kundenstamms
* Organisation und teilweise operative Unterstützung bei Spezial-, Grund- und Endreinigungen
* Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung interner Abläufe und Prozesse
* Enge, aber wenig kleinteilige Zusammenarbeit mit den Eigentümern (u.a. eine wöchentliche operative Sitzung)
*Ihr Profil*
* Erfahrung in der Reinigungsbranche ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung – Einarbeitung erfolgt
* Erste Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung mit operativer Verantwortung
* Hohe Selbständigkeit – Sie suchen sich Arbeit und Lösungen selbst, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten
* Unternehmerisches Denken und ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein
* Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude daran, selbst operativ mitzuarbeiten
* Freude am Kontakt mit Kunden und aktiver Akquise
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse
* Führerausweis Kategorie B
*Was geboten wird*
* Einen fairen, guten Lohn als Basis
* Eine sofortige Anstellung im vereinbarten Pensum ab Start
* Beteiligung am Deckungsbeitrag bei selbst akquirierten Neuaufträgen
* Mitarbeiterbeteiligung
* Viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum
* Direkte und unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit mit den Eigentümern
* Eine junge Firma mit grossem Entwicklungspotenzial – fachlich und finanziell
